name: Lu Thai Textile Co., Ltd.
summary: Lu Thai Textile Co., Ltd., along with its affiliated companies, operates as a prominent manufacturer and distributor of textile products. The company specializes in creating both yarn-dyed and other finished fabrics primarily for shirts and various apparel. Their extensive product portfolio encompasses a diverse array of yarns, including combed cotton and various blends. They also produce fabrics crafted from a wide range of materials such as cotton, synthetic fibers, silk, wool, and other components. Beyond raw materials, Lu Thai Textile also offers finished shirts and specialized fabric types, including non-iron, white, multi-component, digitally printed, stretch, and specific fabrics for trousers and general garments. These products are marketed under their proprietary brand names: LUTHAI, LT-GRFF, BESSSHIRT, and CAVAD. The company boasts a significant global footprint, with operations spanning across Mainland China, Hong Kong, Japan, South Korea, various regions in Southeast Asia, Europe, and the United States, alongside other international markets. Lu Thai Textile was established in 1993 and maintains its headquarters in Zibo, located in the People's Republic of China.
